description: Posts as a grid, a list or a magazine.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and the posts as cards: a grid, a list of horizontal cards, or a magazine (the first
  post wide, the rest in a grid). Axes: layout (grid, list, magazine), columns, media, meta (full, short, news),
  filter mode (none, topics), pager (none, pages), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { PostTopic, PostFilter, PostPager } from "./post-grid.types";
  import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";
  import type { HeadLink } from "../components/section-frame.types";

  export type PostGridProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    posts: Post[];
    labels: PostLabels;
    action?: HeadLink;
    filter?: PostFilter;
    pager?: PostPager;
    layout?: "grid" | "list" | "magazine";
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
    media?: "image" | "none";
    meta?: "full" | "short" | "news";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    ontopic?: (value: string) => void;
    onpage?: (page: number) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Pager from "../components/pager.svelte";
  import PostCard from "../blocks/post-card.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import Switcher from "../components/switcher.svelte";
  import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.svelte";
  import { fitCols, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    posts,
    labels,
    action,
    filter,
    pager,
    layout = "grid",
    cols = "1-3",
    media = "image",
    meta = "full",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    ontopic,
    onpage,
  }: PostGridProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  action={action}
  tone={tone}
  density={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "compact" : "default")}
  measure={(((meta as string) === "news") ? "fill" : "default")}
  class={(((meta as string) === "news") ? "py-0" : "")}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if (filter?.mode === "topics")}
    <Switcher label={filter?.label}>
      {#each filter?.topics as tab (tab.id)}
        <SwitcherItem active={(tab.value === filter?.topic)} onclick={() => ontopic?.(tab.value)}>
          {tab.title}
        </SwitcherItem>
      {/each}
    </Switcher>
  {/if}
  {#if ((posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i["category"] === filter?.topic)?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
    {#if ((layout as string) === "magazine")}
      <Stack gap="6" align="stretch" data-slot="items">
        {#each posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i["category"] === filter?.topic) as p, i (p.id)}
          {#if (i === 0)}
            <PostCard post={p} labels={labels} layout="horizontal" media={media} meta={meta} density={density} />
          {/if}
        {/each}
        <Grid cols={cols} class="gap-6">
          {#each posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i["category"] === filter?.topic) as p, i (p.id)}
            {#if (i > 0)}
              <PostCard post={p} labels={labels} media={media} meta={meta} density={density} />
            {/if}
          {/each}
        </Grid>
      </Stack>
    {:else}
      <Grid
        cols={
          (layout as string) === "list" ? "1"
          : fitCols(cols, (posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i["category"] === filter?.topic)?.length ?? 0))
        }
        class="w-full gap-6"
        data-slot="items"
      >
        {#each posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i["category"] === filter?.topic) as p (p.id)}
          <PostCard
            post={p}
            labels={labels}
            layout={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "horizontal" : "vertical")}
            media={media}
            meta={meta}
            density={density}
          />
        {/each}
      </Grid>
    {/if}
  {/if}
  {#if ((pager?.mode === "pages") && ((posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i["category"] === filter?.topic)?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
    <Block
      tag="nav"
      aria-label={
        landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", pager?.label, landmarkLabel))
        : pager?.label
      }
      data-slot="posts-pager"
    >
      <Pager
        page={(pager?.page ?? 1)}
        pages={(pager?.pages ?? 1)}
        summary={tpl(pager?.summary, (pager?.page ?? 1), (pager?.pages ?? 1))}
        previousLabel={(pager?.previous ?? "")}
        nextLabel={(pager?.next ?? "")}
        numbered={true}
        pageLabel={pager?.pageLabel}
        pageUrl={pager?.url}
        firstUrl={pager?.firstUrl}
        onpage={(arg: number) => onpage?.(arg)}
      />
    </Block>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
